registrationNote: Written before the first SDK experiment result. Future runs record this file SHA-256.

hypotheses.claim: Seeded grammar reproducibility and bounded structural variation
hypotheses.oracle: Independent Node SHA-256 of serialized full surfaces; independent signature of parent/child semantic tree and relative region reading order, without hashes/seed/coordinates; canonical manifest reconstruction. One valid added edge must retain supported required actions; structural and coordinate response reported without requiring change.
hypotheses.metric: 1000 duplicate-seed replay checks, content uniqueness, SDK and independent structural equivalence counts, 6x6 layout metrics, one-edge response
hypotheses.falsificationThreshold: Any replay mismatch, invalid geometry, duplicate semantic region, missing required supported action, unreachable action, unsupported action, or manifest replay mismatch falsifies H1/H2 hard gates. Uniqueness has no pass threshold and does not establish usability.

hypotheses.claim: Required capabilities preserved across six display rewrites
hypotheses.oracle: Read semantic graph directly to enumerate supported action IDs; check each required ID exists exactly once, appears in finite positive visible-width region with minimum 24px action dimensions, viewport containment, vertical scroll allowed, semantic reading order and region non-overlap.
hypotheses.metric: 36 family/display combinations, independently derived action and region constraints
hypotheses.falsificationThreshold: Zero hard constraint failures required; no aesthetic claim from geometry alone.

hypotheses.claim: Chromatic fields satisfy AA role contrast and bounded sRGB in light/dark
hypotheses.oracle: Independent hex decoder and W3C relative luminance formula (sRGB breakpoint 0.04045), text/background and text/surface, muted/surface, accentText/accent; negative controls same color and low contrast must be caught; gamut independently check 0..1.
hypotheses.metric: 200 seeds x 2 modes x 3 event states; out-of-gamut OKLCH cases; exact replay
hypotheses.falsificationThreshold: Any normal-text role ratio below 4.5:1 (tolerance 1e-9), nondeterminism, invalid hex, out-of-gamut mapped component, or undetected negative control fails.

hypotheses.claim: Fixed-step event physics is deterministic, bounded, stable and effect-free
hypotheses.oracle: Independent finiteness/position/velocity/field checks, direct quantized snapshot comparison after reversed event enqueue order, settled-energy comparison after input ends, zero-force stationary baseline, reduced-motion displacement, tick batching replay, duplicate/invalid input rejection.
hypotheses.metric: 100 seeded worlds x 1200 ticks, 2400-tick stress chain, event-order replay, quiescent/energy/diffusion extrema
hypotheses.falsificationThreshold: No NaN/Infinity, abs(position)<1e6, abs(velocity)<1e5, abs(field)<1e3, final mechanical energy <= peak post-event energy +1e-6, identical snapshots for equal events and batching, duplicate event rejection; 10000 ticks rejected or bounded to <=10000 actual ticks. CPU timings descriptive only.

hypotheses.claim: Typed performer pipelines reject schema/effect mismatches
hypotheses.oracle: Adversarial invalid runtime shape, incompatible adjacent schema IDs, unknown operation and unauthorized effects; valid pure pipeline yields reconstructable trace and deterministic output. Independent pack metadata inspection.
hypotheses.metric: Positive composition plus independent schema/effect/shape rejection cases
hypotheses.falsificationThreshold: Any invalid acceptance, undeclared effects, or missing trace fails; exact supported API recorded from SDK implementation.

hypotheses.claim: Visual reproduction fidelity without invariant regressions
hypotheses.oracle: External Playwright screenshots, accessibility, boxes, keyboard, semantic action map and clipping/contrast/wrong-action negative controls; reference identity reproduction separate from aesthetic judgment.
hypotheses.metric: Root Playwright evidence, pixel delta when baseline exists
hypotheses.falsificationThreshold: Pending until external evidence exists; no visual similarity improvement claim without before/after reference results.

hypotheses.claim: NASA and restaurant semantic intent are distinguishable and evidence grounded
hypotheses.oracle: Read fixture passages manually for domain anchors (NASA/science vs menu/prices); compare inferred research/commerce intent and ensure intent evidence references actual graph IDs or verbatim source evidence; all actions from supported local/safe-open vocabulary.
hypotheses.metric: NASA/menu intent classifications and confidence, evidence coverage, action whitelist
hypotheses.falsificationThreshold: NASA research or menu commerce absent, equal dominant intent, missing evidence, unsupported action, or nondeterministic parse fails; generalization beyond these authored fixtures untested.

paretoNote: Dominance compares independently checked feasible surfaces only; scores are SDK descriptive proxies, not validated perceptual quality. Equal vectors share rank.
